theme: Housing & Building-Products Recovery / commercial-glass + infra-water decoupled rung (decoupled-leader escape: TGLS)

three_judgments.path: NO credible path of either kind (automatic DROP). Cap ~$1.93B; 4x⇒~$7.7B EV needs ~$770M EBITDA @10x (~3.3x current ~$235M), 3x⇒~$5.8B — both a decade+ away at ~11% rev growth with compressing margins, far outside 2-4yr. Realistic bull (full margin recovery to ~31% by 2027 ⇒ ~$340M EBITDA on ~$1.25B rev × peak-cycle ~12x = ~$4.1B EV ≈ ~2.1x) stacks a full margin recovery ON a full re-rate and STILL falls short of even the 3x great-trade floor. Squares with analyst FV ~$71.50 (~1.6x). Discriminators: backlog accelerating+CONVERTING is genuinely PRESENT (B2B 1.3x, 21 consec qtrs >1.1x, backlog $1.36B +19%, converting to record rev) — but converts at only ~11-12% growth; margin/CF inflection is INVERTED (EBITDA declined YoY, margins compressing, not the bullish §7 inflection); no on-date binary milestone (US plant = feasibility study, land-only 2026); no single Tier-1 cash anchor. SHOWS real-but-slow conversion; does not SHOW a ≥3-4x mechanism.
three_judgments.asymmetry: WEAK. Bull ~2x (full margin recovery + modest re-rate), base ~1.3-1.6x (analyst FV), bear ~-30-40% (cyclical building-products de-rate if commercial/multifamily rolls + margins stay compressed). U/D roughly symmetric-to-modestly-favorable — a respectable quality-compounder profile, nowhere near venture-book asymmetry; doesn't earn a scarce deep-dive slot.
three_judgments.survival: BULLETPROOF — no ruin, no impairment risk. Net debt ~0.4x EBITDA, ~$425M liquidity (~$330M+ revolver), GAAP-profitable (P/E ~12.9x), returns capital. Survival is the opposite of a problem — but it cannot rescue a name with no path.

strongest_bear: Well-run, reasonably-priced (~7.3x EV/EBITDA) cyclical building-products compounder — but a ~$1.9B-cap growing revenue ~11% with margins actively compressing from tariffs/mix (earnings went sideways-to-DOWN YoY). The multiple is already fair, not depressed, so there's no re-rating spring; realistic 2-3yr outcome is the analyst ~$71.50 (~1.6x). Reaching even 3x requires a full margin recovery AND a peak-cycle multiple AND years of compounding stacked together — and still falls short. A good business, wrong instrument for a venture book.
drop_reason: no-path — reviewer-suspected great-trade/≥4x path REFUTED on current data: at ~$1.93B cap, ~11% revenue growth with compressing margins gives no credible ≥4x or high-confidence protected 3-4x (realistic bull ~2x, analyst FV ~1.6x); the original T1 trap-flavored reason was wrong but the correct DROP is geometry/no-path (J1 automatic), reinforced by weak asymmetry (J2). Real decoupled-backlog conversion is genuine but only low-double-digit — strong proxy for a slow rung, not a shot. Theme stays live in the Tier-0 map.
